DeckBracket.title: Bracket {level} · {label}
DeckBracket.methodology: Minimum bracket per <0>edhpowerlevel</0>’s algorithm: Game Changers, MLD, extra turns, and early game-defining combos.
DeckBracket.provenance: Card data from Scryfall; combos from Commander Spellbook, which receives the main deck’s card names and quantities.

consent.prompt: Bracket analysis sends this deck’s card names to Scryfall (Game Changers list and card text), and the main deck’s card names and quantities to Commander Spellbook (combos). Choose Enable to estimate when you ask, or Automatic to estimate whenever the deck changes.

DeckBracket.partialNotice: Partial estimate: this deck may sit in a higher bracket. It isn’t saved with the deck until every source answers.
